// diagnostic

E1803

Application authority is undecided or denies a required effect; the report names `required_effects`, `granted_effects`, `denied_effects`, and `authority` separately.

What

Application authority is undecided or denies a required effect; the report names `required_effects`, `granted_effects`, `denied_effects`, and `authority` separately.

Why

The effect projection distinguishes sema requirements from policy grants, denials, and the policy identity; execution stops before host state changes.

Fix

Add `allow: [IO, Mem.Alloc, Exec]` under `authority.holds` in `package.jet` (use every value in this report's `undecided_effects` list); otherwise deny effects deliberately, or approve the exact operation once or for the project in an interactive terminal.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1803: tests/ui/env_config_secret_redacted.stderr.

Error [E1803]: application authority is undecided for `Env`
 Why: required_effects=Env, Mem.Alloc, Panic; granted_effects=Exec, IO, Mem.Alloc; denied_effects=none; denied_required_effects=none; undecided_effects=Env; authority=application default
 Fix: add `allow: [Env]` under `authority.holds` in `package.jet`; otherwise deny effects deliberately, or approve the exact operation once or for the project in an interactive terminal
